name: OpenFlight IWR6843LEVM calibration - Robinante unit - PROVISIONAL (TrackMan 2026-10-04)
scope: PROVISIONAL. Only tilt_deg differs from config/iwr6843_calibration_reference.json. It is an EFFECTIVE tilt fitted to 7 TrackMan shots (one session); it may be absorbing per-board element-phase error. Replace with a measured tilt plus a per-board corner-reflector solve when available. Horizontal launch is NOT calibrated by this file.
convention: apply to x8[::-1] (physical order); x8_cal = x8_flipped * exp(-1j*phase_rad) / gain

provisional.based_on: config/iwr6843_calibration_reference.json (2026-07-12); elem_phase_rad, elem_gain, range_* and radar_height_m copied unchanged
provisional.fit_data: session 20261004_095102 vs TrackMan; 7 captures with a real ball track (TM 30, 38, 45, 46, 47, 52, 54); see trackman_openflight_aligned.csv
provisional.fit_method: offline LCMF-v1 replay of the saved l3dumps, tilt swept 0-12 deg in 0.25 deg steps, minimum mean |IWR VLA - TrackMan VLA| with all 7 accepted
caveats: 7 shots, one session, one golfer; 5 irons (TrackMan VLA 17-19 deg) and 2 low 5-woods (2.4 and 3.2 deg).
Per-shot error vs tilt is non-monotonic (estimator mode switching); the 4.25-5.0 deg region is the most stable.
tee and tilt were never physically measured; tee was the 1.575 m default.

horizontal_phase_reference_rad: not fitted. In these 7 shots TrackMan HLA and VLA correlate at 0.92, so horizontal phase cannot be separated from launch height; no reference under the repo sign convention fits (leave-one-out MAE ~15 deg).
